1. ones

Pseudocode

def loop_ones(n):
    out = jnp.zeros((n,), dtype=jnp.float32)
    for i in range(n):
        out = out.at[i].set(1.)
    return out

2. sum

Pseudocode

def loop_sum(a):
    out = jnp.zeros((1,), dtype=a.dtype)
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        out = out.at[0].set(out[0] + a[i])
    return out[0]

JAX NumPy

@jax.jit
def puzzle_sum(a):
    return a @ jnp.ones_like(a)

3. outer

Pseudocode

def loop_outer(a, b):
    out = jnp.zeros((a.shape[0], b.shape[0]), dtype=a.dtype)
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        for j in range(b.shape[0]):
            out = out.at[i, j].set(a[i] * b[j])
    return out

JAX NumPy

@jax.jit
def puzzle_outer(a, b):
    return a[:, None] * b[None, :]

def loop_triu(n):
    out = jnp.zeros((n, n), dtype=jnp.float32)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i <= j:
                out = out.at[i, j].set(1.)
    return out

    i = arange(n)
    return jnp.where(i[:, None] <= i[None, :], 1., 0.)

7. cumsum

Pseudocode

def loop_cumsum(a):
    out = jnp.zeros_like(a)
    total = 0.
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        total = total + a[i]
        out = out.at[i].set(total)
    return out

JAX NumPy

@jax.jit
def puzzle_cumsum(a):
    i = arange(a.shape[0])

15. bincount

Pseudocode

@jax.jit
def loop_masked_sum(values, mask):
    total = 0.
    for i in range(values.shape[0]):
        total = total + jnp.where(mask[i], values[i], 0.)
    return total
def loop_bincount(a, n):
    out = jnp.zeros((n,), dtype=jnp.float32)
    for j in range(n):
        out = out.at[j].set(loop_masked_sum(jnp.ones(a.shape), a.astype(jnp.float32) == j))
    return out

JAX NumPy

def puzzle_bincount(a, n):
    bins = arange(n)
    return jnp.sum(jnp.where(a.astype(jnp.float32)[None, :] == bins[:, None], 1., 0.), axis=1)

def loop_flatten(a):
    out = jnp.zeros((a.size,), dtype=a.dtype)
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        for j in range(a.shape[1]):
            out = out.at[i * a.shape[1] + j].set(a[i, j])
    return out

def loop_linspace(start, stop, n):
    out = jnp.zeros((n,), dtype=jnp.float32)
    for i in range(n):
        out = out.at[i].set(start + (stop - start) * i / max(1, n - 1))
    return out

Pseudocode

def loop_heaviside(a, b):
    out = jnp.zeros_like(a)
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        out = out.at[i].set(jnp.where(a[i] == 0., b[i], jnp.where(a[i] > 0., 1., 0.)))
    return out

def puzzle_heaviside(a, b):
    return jnp.where(a == 0., b, jnp.where(a > 0., 1., 0.))

20. repeat

def loop_repeat(a, n):
    out = jnp.zeros((n, a.shape[0]), dtype=a.dtype)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(a.shape[0]):
            out = out.at[i, j].set(a[j])
    return out

    return jnp.broadcast_to(a, (n, a.shape[0]))

21. bucketize

Pseudocode

def loop_bucketize(v, boundaries):
    out = jnp.zeros_like(v)
    for i in range(v.shape[0]):
        bucket = 0.
        for j in range(boundaries.shape[0]):
            bucket = jnp.where(v[i] >= boundaries[j], float(j + 1), bucket)
        out = out.at[i].set(bucket)
    return out

JAX NumPy

def puzzle_bucketize(v, boundaries):
    positions = arange(boundaries.shape[0]) + 1.
    return jnp.max(jnp.where(v[:, None] >= boundaries[None, :], positions[None, :], 0.), axis=1)

Variance · sixteen independent dice

JAX NumPy

def die_draw(key):
    return jax.random.randint(key, (), 1, 7).astype(jnp.float32)
def die_estimate(draws):
    return jnp.mean(draws)
def mc_die_16(key):
    keys = jax.random.split(key, 16)
    return die_estimate(jax.vmap(die_draw)(keys))

Ideal sampling model

abbrev dieLaw : Rand ℝ := Rand.uniformInt 1 6 (⊢ 0 < 6 All goals completed! 🐙)theorem mc_die_boundary : mc_die_16 (R := ℝ) = Rand.map (fun draws => die_estimate (fun i => draws i.1) ()) (Rand.iid 16 dieLaw) := rfl

Variance proof

⊢ (∑ i, (Rand.map (fun v => v) dieLaw).variance) / 16 ^ 2 = dieLaw.variance / 16 ⊢ (∑ x, dieLaw.variance) / 16 ^ 2 = dieLaw.variance / 16 ⊢ ↑16 * dieLaw.variance / 16 ^ 2 = dieLaw.variance / 16 All goals completed! 🐙⊢ 35 / 12 / 16 = 35 / 192 All goals completed! 🐙

Certificate

⊢ mc_die_16.variance = 35 / 192 All goals completed! 🐙

Variance · square then average

JAX NumPy

def grid_index(key):
    return jax.random.randint(key, (), 0, 4).astype(jnp.float32)
@jax.jit
def grid_square(index):
    return (index / 4.0) ** 2
def grid_estimate(indices):
    return jnp.mean(grid_square(indices))
def mc_grid_square_8(key):
    keys = jax.random.split(key, 8)
    return grid_estimate(jax.vmap(grid_index)(keys))

Ideal sampling model

abbrev gridIndexLaw : Rand ℝ := Rand.uniformInt 0 4 (⊢ 0 < 4 All goals completed! 🐙)def gridValueLaw : Rand ℝ := Rand.map (fun v => (v / 4) ^ (2 : Nat)) gridIndexLawtheorem mc_grid_boundary : mc_grid_square_8 (R := ℝ) = Rand.map (fun draws => grid_estimate (fun i => draws i.1) ()) (Rand.iid 8 gridIndexLaw) := rfl

Variance proof

⊢ (∑ i, (Rand.map (fun v => (v / 4) ^ 2) gridIndexLaw).variance) / 8 ^ 2 = gridValueLaw.variance / 8 ⊢ (∑ x, gridValueLaw.variance) / 8 ^ 2 = gridValueLaw.variance / 8 ⊢ ↑8 * gridValueLaw.variance / 8 ^ 2 = gridValueLaw.variance / 8 All goals completed! 🐙⊢ 49 / 1024 / 8 = 49 / 8192 All goals completed! 🐙

Physics · advect

JAX NumPy

def advect(u, c):
    flux = c * u
    return u - (flux - jnp.roll(flux, 1))

Specification

def fluxStep {R : Type} [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (flux : R → R) (x : Tensor R [n]) : Tensor R [n] := fun i => x i - (flux (x i) - flux (permute p x i))def neighbor := cyclicShift 3 1theorem advect_spec (u : Tensor ℝ [4]) (c : Tensor ℝ []) : Advect.advect u c = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) u := u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []⊢ Advect.advect u c = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) u u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []⊢ map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) u (map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) (map (fun a0 => c () * a0) u) (permute neighbor (map (fun a0 => c () * a0) u))) = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) u All goals completed! 🐙

Correctness proof

theorem advect_equivariant (u : Tensor ℝ [4]) (c : Tensor ℝ []) (k : ℤ) : Advect.advect (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) c = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Advect.advect u c) := u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ Advect.advect (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) c = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Advect.advect u c) u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) u) All goals completed! 🐙

Conservation

u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []⊢ ∑ i, fluxStep neighbor (fun z => c () * z) u (i, ()) = ∑ i, u (i, ()) All goals completed! 🐙

Certificate

theorem advect_certificate (u : Tensor ℝ [4]) (c : Tensor ℝ []) (k : ℤ) : Jaxpr.Program.eval (.cons (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) (.cons c .nil)) Advect.advect_ir = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Jaxpr.Program.eval (.cons u (.cons c .nil)) Advect.advect_ir) := u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ Jaxpr.Program.eval (Jaxpr.Env.cons (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) (Jaxpr.Env.cons c Jaxpr.Env.nil)) Advect.advect_ir = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Jaxpr.Program.eval (Jaxpr.Env.cons u (Jaxpr.Env.cons c Jaxpr.Env.nil)) Advect.advect_ir) u:Tensor ℝ [4]c:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ Advect.advect (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) c = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Advect.advect u c) All goals completed! 🐙

Physics · burgers

JAX NumPy

def burgers(u, lam):
    flux = 0.5 * u**2
    return u - lam * (flux - jnp.roll(flux, 1))

Specification

theorem burgers_spec (u : Tensor ℝ [4]) (lam : Tensor ℝ []) : Burgers.burgers u lam = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) u := u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []⊢ Burgers.burgers u lam = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) u u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []⊢ map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) u (map (fun a0 => lam () * a0) (map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) (map (fun a0 => scalar (1 / 2) () * a0) (map (fun x => x ^ 2) u)) (permute neighbor (map (fun a0 => scalar (1 / 2) () * a0) (map (fun x => x ^ 2) u))))) = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) u u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []i:Index [4]⊢ map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) u (map (fun a0 => lam () * a0) (map₂ (fun a0 a1 => a0 - a1) (map (fun a0 => scalar (1 / 2) () * a0) (map (fun x => x ^ 2) u)) (permute neighbor (map (fun a0 => scalar (1 / 2) () * a0) (map (fun x => x ^ 2) u))))) i = fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) u i u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []i:Index [4]⊢ u i - lam () * (1 / 2 * u i ^ 2 - 1 / 2 * u (neighbor i.1, ()) ^ 2) = u i - (lam () * (1 / 2 * u i ^ 2) - lam () * (1 / 2 * u (neighbor i.1, ()) ^ 2)) All goals completed! 🐙

Correctness proof

theorem burgers_equivariant (u : Tensor ℝ [4]) (lam : Tensor ℝ []) (k : ℤ) : Burgers.burgers (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) lam = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Burgers.burgers u lam) := u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ Burgers.burgers (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) lam = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (Burgers.burgers u lam) u:Tensor ℝ [4]lam:Tensor ℝ []k:ℤ⊢ fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) (permute (cyclicShift 3 k) u) = permute (cyclicShift 3 k) (fluxStep neighbor (fun z => lam () * (1 / 2 * z ^ 2)) u) All goals completed! 🐙
